report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified. Current traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and DB spans returning 200/ok, and order metrics show 0 502s and 8 successful /v1/orders on v1.0.0. The only deployment record is a baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, which cannot establish deployment-caused failure. Logs were excluded and no error evidence exists, so no bounded root cause is supported; hand off for more evidence.
